intro: The Reel tells one night at a bar in steps: be seen, get a hello, keep the talk going, get a yes, and stay together. AYBKK walks the same steps on two paths. Path 1 is the Bangkok shala: a Reel or a Google search, our Instagram profile, a LINE chat, a first morning, a pass, then a renewal; Path 2 is In-Depth Mysore, the 180,000 baht program (we call it 180K): a Reel or the Monday letter (our free weekly letter), a DM (a private message), a one-page plan, an application with a practice video, a call, then payment.

terms.bar: You walk into the bar, but no girl even sees you. Nobody knows you are there. That is low traffic.
terms.meaning: Traffic is how many people see you at all: views on a Reel, people who find us on Google Maps, visits to aybkk.net. With no traffic, nobody can even start the path.
terms.shala: People in Bangkok see a Reel, a carousel (a post with up to 10 slides), our Google Maps listing or a Google photo post. Low traffic means people nearby who want a morning practice never hear that the shala exists.
terms.indepth: Long-time practitioners in China, Russia and the West see a Hidden Stories Reel, a WeChat post or the Monday letter. Low traffic means serious people never meet Boonchu's teaching, so nobody starts the road to an application.
terms.count: Instagram insights (the numbers Instagram shows for each post) give views per Reel and carousel, and Postiz (the tool that schedules our posts) shows what went out and when. Machi asks Boonchu for the Google Business Profile numbers (our Google Maps listing) on the 1st (asked 1 Nov). No November numbers are in the notes yet. Google Ads shows impressions (how many times an ad was shown) for the brand search ad (it shows when people type aybkk) and the Bangkok search ad. The staff page counts visits to each aybkk.net/start link (a road gets its own link, like /start/google, so we can count it).

fixes.name: Hidden Stories of Ashtanga (Reel series)
fixes.how: Boonchu tells an old Indian myth in bedtime-story words and ties it to one asana; the episodes are made to reach serious practitioners, and the Ramayana run rides on the new Ramayana movie in Bangkok cinemas. New scripts have been paused since 22 Oct (only the Ramayana run is allowed), and the last episode posted was Ep. 5 on 4 Nov.
fixes.source: plato.md Standing orders 2026-09-28 SERIES NAME, 2026-10-22 STOP WRITING, 2026-11-04 EP. 5 POSTED, 2026-11-11 RAMAYANA RUN

fixes.name: Google Business Profile photo posts
fixes.how: Plato drafts photo posts for our Google listing for Wednesday, Friday and Sunday, each with a Book button and its own link, and Boonchu says go on each one. Every post says 'Sukhumvit 31', because a rival yoga studio now owns that search.
fixes.source: plato.md Jobs from Machi 2026-10-15 GOOGLE BUSINESS PHOTO POSTS (updates to 2026-11-09); plato.md Reel Toolkit 2026-10-18 QUESTION BANK

fixes.name: Question bank (answer what people search)
fixes.how: Pieces answer what people type into search, in EN, TH, ZH and RU, with the exact searched words in the first line, so our piece can show up when they look. At most one answer piece a week goes in the Monday TRUST slot, and that slot is part of the Power, Trust, Likeness plan, which still waits on Boonchu's yes.
fixes.source: plato.md Reel Toolkit 2026-10-18 QUESTION BANK; machiavelli.md Open items 2026-10-17 (Power, Trust, Likeness) and 2026-10-18 (QUESTION BANK)

fixes.name: Fix maps and business listings
fixes.how: Google shows evening hours that don't exist, Apple Maps has the wrong name, address and phone, and OSM (a free world map) calls the shala a clinic, so people who already search a map are sent wrong or put off. The site part is live; the listing fixes are a front-desk checklist that is not done yet.
fixes.source: machiavelli.md, Open items 2026-10-29 (map apps); Reminders '12 Nov 2026, 07:08 (price switch)'

terms.next: M at the front desk: this week, fix the wrong free map listings from the front-desk checklist, starting with Google's evening hours that don't exist and Apple Maps' wrong name, address and phone. People who already search for us then find the right door, at no cost.
terms.careful: Trap: chasing views with a trend that leads nowhere. A trend is fine only if the piece still leads to a trial, a renewal or the 180K program.

terms.bar: Girls see you, but none of them smiles back or comes over to say hello. They noticed you and walked on. That is a low click-through rate.
terms.meaning: Click-through rate is how many of the people who saw you took the first small step: tapped the link, opened the profile, commented, or tapped Book. It is written as a share of 100: 21 clicks from 72 ad views is about 29 in 100.
terms.shala: Someone sees a Reel or our Google listing and then acts: opens the profile, comments 'aybkk' to get the link, or taps Book or LINE on a /start page (the first page people land on from a link). Low click-through means they liked what they saw and scrolled on.
terms.indepth: A serious practitioner watches a Hidden Stories Reel or reads the Monday letter and then comments STUCK (the word we ask serious practitioners to comment), replies to the letter, or opens aybkk.net/in-depth. Low click-through means they enjoy the story but never take the first step toward us.
terms.count: Instagram insights show profile visits and link taps for each Reel. Google Ads shows clicks per ad view (brand ad, 7 days to 2 Nov: 72 views, 21 clicks). The staff page counts visits, Book taps and LINE taps for each /start link. The keyword test was meant to count LINE chats whose first message contains 'start/ig-aybkk' or 'start/line-aybkk'. It has been on hold since 24 Oct (Boonchu did not answer by the deadline, so Machi's default B, hold, applied) and restarts only after Boonchu approves the week 1 Batch Sheet (Plato's plan for one week of filming) and films it; its 26 Oct to 22 Nov window would need new dates.

fixes.name: Triple Hook with say/show/write
fixes.how: A hook is the first line that makes people stop scrolling; the Triple Hook gives the context, then what the viewer thinks, then the twist, and the context is said, shown and written on screen in the first second, so people know what this is before they decide to swipe. The say/show/write check was added on 4 Nov and no posted Reel uses it yet (the 4 Oct Flexible or Stiff? Reel used the older Triple Hook, and its quick first comment came from the self-joke ending, not the hook).
fixes.source: plato.md Reel Toolkit, Triple Hook (UPDATE 2026-11-04); Standing orders 2026-11-04 TRIPLE HOOK LINE 1 CHECK; What worked 2026-10-04

fixes.name: First 3 seconds hit the viewer's own problem
fixes.how: The first 3 seconds must hit the viewer's own problem or open a question, before any myth or text, and every Reel must still make sense with the sound off. A word meaning or a teaching line alone makes people scroll away, as Boonchu said when the Gu-Ru Reel was dropped.
fixes.source: plato.md What worked 2026-10-12 DROPPED Gu-Ru Reel; Reel Toolkit, Obsidian frameworks, 3-Second Audit

fixes.name: Google review ask at the 12-week check and at renewal
fixes.how: On Google, people see our 4.1 stars from 22 reviews next to rivals at 4.8 to 5.0, and may tap the rivals instead; more real reviews make our listing worth tapping. aybkk.net/review opens Google's review form, and a card in My account asks once the 12-week check is done or the student renews. Ask everyone, no gift.
fixes.source: machiavelli.md Open items 2026-11-13 00:30, 2026-11-12 22:35, 2026-11-12 22:15; carnegie.md Jobs from Machi 2026-10-15 (Google report) REVIEW ASK

fixes.name: One clear ask
fixes.how: Every piece ends with exactly one thing to do: try Mysore, the 12-week check, or ask on LINE @aybkk. One ask is easier to act on than three.
fixes.source: /home/user/bots-mem/bots/direction.md, '10 HABITS FRAME > Rules' and 'Per bot > Plato'

terms.next: Boonchu merges draft PR #109, the Google review card (a PR is a website change waiting to go live; merging puts it live). The card asks every student the same way, at the 12-week check or at renewal, with no gift. The desk also asks students in turn, not only the happy ones, because Google forbids picking who to ask. Staff never review the shala.
terms.careful: Trap: a hook that scares people about their health or promises a result. It may get taps, but from the wrong people, and it breaks our rules. Hook with something true from the viewer's own life.

terms.bar: She starts talking to you, then walks away after a few seconds. The talk began, but nothing held her. That is a high bounce rate.
terms.meaning: Bounce rate is how many people arrive and leave almost at once: they open the page or start the video, then go. A high bounce rate means the first seconds did not give them what they hoped for.
terms.shala: Someone taps through to aybkk.net or a /start page and leaves without scrolling or tapping, or starts a Reel and swipes away. On the site this happens when the page is long or slow, or the booking is hard to find.
terms.indepth: A practitioner opens aybkk.net/in-depth or the private Chinese page and leaves, or starts a Hidden Stories Reel and swipes away. For China, a page that loads slowly behind China's internet block, or a clumsy Chinese translation, can make a serious buyer leave.
terms.count: Instagram insights show average watch time for each Reel and a graph of how many people are still watching at each second. No average watch time has been logged yet. The only number in What worked is the 4 a.m. Reel's 60% scrolled away (12 Oct). For aybkk.net, the staff page counts visits and Book or LINE taps per /start link, so visits with no tap roughly show who left. A real web bounce rate is not counted yet; Neo could count visits that leave with no scroll and no tap.

fixes.name: Keep-watching map on every script
fixes.how: Each script line gets a label: hook (0 to 3 seconds), a second hook by about 5 seconds, an open loop (a question left open, so people stay to hear the answer), a rehook (a new pull where attention drops), and the payoff (the answer). Every open loop gets paid off, so people have a reason to stay to the end.
fixes.source: plato.md Standing orders 2026-10-28 RETENTION MAP

fixes.name: Curiosity-first order for joke Reels
fixes.how: The 4 a.m. Reel lost 60% of viewers because the joke came too late. Joke Reels now open a question in the first 3 seconds and save the punch for the end.
fixes.source: plato.md Standing orders 2026-10-12 REEL ORDER FOR JOKE REELS; What worked 2026-10-12 WHAT DID NOT WORK

fixes.name: Shorter home page with booking near the top
fixes.how: Booking moved to section 2 and long sections fold behind 'Read more', so a phone visitor now reaches booking in 1.4 screens instead of 2.5. Less scrolling to the thing they came for should mean fewer people give up.
fixes.source: machiavelli.md, Open items 2026-11-07 06:58, 2026-11-04 (Swiss grid, monthly theme)

fixes.name: China-proof pages
fixes.how: Fonts are kept on our own server because Google Fonts is blocked in China, so our pages load there instead of hanging.
fixes.source: /home/user/aybkk-workshop/CLAUDE.md, 'Key Facts > Bangkok shala' and 'Custom Slash Commands > /shop'

fixes.name: One core letter, three language versions
fixes.how: A native speaker reads every language version out loud before it goes out, because a clumsy Chinese translation looks cheap to 180K buyers and makes them close it.
fixes.source: halbert-letter.md, Part 5 (3 weak spots, Munger check, One core three versions); carnegie.md Log 2026-11-02 (chat)

terms.next: Plato: after each new Reel, write its average watch time and the second where most people leave into What worked, so the keep-watching map is judged by real numbers. Boonchu sends the Instagram screenshot, because bots never log in to Instagram.
terms.careful: Trap: a slow, clever opening. If the point does not land in about 6 seconds, people swipe, however good the story is later.

terms.bar: She enjoys the talk, but at the end of the night she says 'good night' and goes home alone. The talk never turned into a yes. That is a low conversion rate.
terms.meaning: Conversion rate is how many of the people who came close actually said yes: booked a first morning, bought a pass, or sent an application. Closing means getting that yes.
terms.shala: Someone chats on LINE, comes for a first morning or a drop-in, and then buys a pass, or does not. The site guides new people to a monthly package: 'New to Mysore style? Start with a monthly package, so the teacher can guide you step by step. Drop-in is for visitors who already know the sequence.'
terms.indepth: Someone sends a DM, reads the one-page plan (no price), applies with a practice video, has a call where the price is given, and pays in full. Low conversion means good people stop between steps, for example after a slow answer to their DM.
terms.count: The conversion tag (a small piece of Google code on aybkk.net) counts Book and LINE taps for Google Ads, but only for visitors who tap OK on the cookie bar (the small box that asks to allow tracking), so it undercounts taps. The staff page counts Book and LINE taps per /start link. The front desk marks whether each drop-in buys a month within 30 days, reported on the 1st of each month. Machi logs new students and renewals each week as wins. In-Depth applications come in through the apply form; calls and payments are counted by Boonchu.

fixes.name: Drop-in test: keep the drop-in price on show, then move people to a month
fixes.how: The drop-in price (1,500 THB) stays on show; a line saying 7 drop-ins cost more than the 1-month pass was planned, but it is not on the site. The desk counts drop-ins who buy a month within 30 days, and Boonchu decides on 31 Jan 2027 whether drop-ins stay.
fixes.source: machiavelli.md, Open items 2026-10-16 (DROP-IN TEST); Reminders '31 Jan 2027'; public/bkk.html drop-in row 'For students who know the sequence' (origin/main)

fixes.name: 'Money today' same-day close list
fixes.how: Machi's 07:08 brief opens with the people on LINE who are ready to pay, so warm buyers can get an answer the same day. It stalls when the answer waits on Boonchu: two people have waited since 7 and 8 Nov and were still waiting on 14 Nov.
fixes.source: bots/board.md, 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-14 · machiavelli; machiavelli.md Open items 2026-11-08

fixes.name: Close with a set first morning / meet the teacher
fixes.how: Someone ready to pay gets a set first-morning day, or an invite to meet the teacher; the aim is that a date turns 'maybe' into 'see you Tuesday', but the notes do not show that result yet. The 7 Nov meet-the-teacher case (the 3-month student) has not closed and was still waiting on 14 Nov.
fixes.source: bots/board.md, 2026-11-03 · machiavelli ('Close it with a first-morning day'); 2026-11-07 · machiavelli; machiavelli.md Open items 2026-11-08

fixes.name: 180K steps, in order
fixes.how: DM, then the one-page plan (no price), then the application with a video, then the call (price given here), then full payment. Each step asks a little more, so the people who reach the call are ready to say yes.
fixes.source: carnegie.md, Log 2026-10-13 (chat), both entries (selling-tricks advice, then 180K Sales Kit)

fixes.name: Same-day replies and the reply house rule
fixes.how: Every message is answered within 24 hours, brief and warm, never 'sorry', and the plan is to answer each new person the same day from 5 approved answers, which still wait for Boonchu's OK. A fast answer catches people while they still want to start.
fixes.source: machiavelli.md, Standing orders 2026-10-17; Open items 2026-11-12 (attract more regular students), 2026-10-17 (Power, Trust, Likeness)

terms.next: Boonchu: today, answer the 3-month student who has waited on LINE since 7 Nov. Keep the one price on aybkk.net (no lower amount, no back-dated start) and offer a set start day when he feels well. Machi drafts the reply (no price in the draft), and Boonchu sends it.
terms.careful: Trap: a discount or a promise to get the yes. One price for everyone, and never promise kilos, a cure or 'every student'.

terms.bar: You buy her a drink so she will give you her attention. You are paying to be noticed. That is paid acquisition.
terms.meaning: Paid acquisition means paying for ads so people see you, instead of waiting to be found for free. It only makes sense if the new students it brings pay back more than the ads cost.
terms.shala: Two Google search ads run: a brand ad that shows when people type aybkk (150 THB a day cap) and a Bangkok ad for people who search ashtanga or mysore in Bangkok (live since 2 Nov). A Facebook ad pack was written and sent to Boonchu for the promo. The notes do not say whether it ran.
terms.indepth: No paid ads for In-Depth. Carne's 17 Oct plan named Google search for the Bangkok shala as the only ad test (no China, Russia, Facebook or Instagram ads), and the Facebook promo ad pack (5 Nov) was a shala exception. In-Depth people come from Reels, the Monday letter, DMs and graduates' workshops.
terms.count: Google Ads shows spend, clicks and cost per click. Brand ad, 7 days to 2 Nov: 72 views, 21 clicks, 356 THB. The Bangkok search ad has a 300 THB daily budget (about 9,000 THB in 30 days). Only Boonchu can open Google Ads (Machi has no access), so he pastes the numbers. New students from each ad are matched by hand using /start/google and /start/gsearch (if the ad's Final URL, the page the ad opens, was changed to /start/gsearch; the notes don't confirm it).

fixes.name: Google ads for ashtanga and mysore searches in Bangkok, with a 30-day stop rule (keep or cut)
fixes.how: The ad shows only to people in Bangkok who search for ashtanga or mysore, so we pay for people who are already looking. Boonchu was asked for the search terms report on 9 Nov, and junk terms become negatives (words that stop the ad from showing); on 2 Dec the ad stays if at least 1 new student came from it, and is cut if none did.
fixes.source: machiavelli.md, Open items 2026-11-02 (Google Ads, Cowork session); Reminders 'Mon 9 Nov 2026' and 'Wed 2 Dec 2026'

fixes.name: Google Ads brand search campaign
fixes.how: A small ad on our own name catches people who already heard of us and lands on aybkk.net/start/google, so its taps are counted apart. Keep it if one new student came from it, cut the budget if not.
fixes.source: machiavelli.md, Reminders '29 Oct 2026' and '22 Oct 2026'; Open items 2026-11-02 (Google Ads, Cowork session)

fixes.name: Conversion tag on Book and LINE taps
fixes.how: One Google tag counts when a visitor taps Book or LINE, so ads are judged by taps, not just clicks. It fires only for visitors who tap OK on the cookie bar, so it undercounts taps; never add a second tag.
fixes.source: machiavelli.md, Open items 2026-11-02 (Google Ads) and 2026-10-15 (merge PR #63)

fixes.name: Bots draft only, no spending
fixes.how: No ad money is spent without Boonchu's 'go' on that exact item, so a bot can never start an ad or raise a budget.
fixes.source: /home/user/aybkk-workshop/CLAUDE.md, 'AYBKK bot team > Hard rules'

fixes.name: Fix order: offer, price, selling, then people
fixes.how: If ads bring people who don't buy, fix the offer first, then the price, then how we sell. More ad money only makes a weak offer cost more.
fixes.source: /home/user/bots-mem/bots/voice/hormozi-advice-voice.md, '5. BUSINESS CHECKS' item 6

terms.next: Boonchu: this week, check the Bangkok ad's Final URL. If it still opens aybkk.net, change it to aybkk.net/start/gsearch, so on 2 Dec we can see which new students came from it and keep it or cut it by the rule.
terms.careful: Trap: more ad money before we know how many new students stay. Paying for people who quit in month 2 is money lost.

terms.bar: You spend a lot of money on drinks just to get one girl to talk to you. Each conversation cost you a lot. That is a high cost per lead.
terms.meaning: A lead is a person who has shown real interest: sent a LINE message, filled a form, or asked a question. Cost per lead is the money spent divided by the number of leads it brought.
terms.shala: A lead is someone who taps LINE or Book, answers the 4-tap question on /start, or comments 'aybkk'. Most of our leads cost no ad money (Reels, our Google listing, the Monday letter), so here cost per lead mostly matters for the Google ads.
terms.indepth: A lead is a serious practitioner who DMs about the program, joins the priority list, or replies 'TT' (teacher training) to the letter. We pay nothing for ads here, so the real cost is Boonchu's time on Reels, letters and replies.
terms.count: For the Google ads: spend in Google Ads divided by Book and LINE taps on the staff page for /start/google and /start/gsearch (if the Final URL was changed to /start/gsearch; the notes don't confirm it). Example from the brand ad, 7 days to 2 Nov: 356 THB for 21 clicks, about 17 THB a click; clicks are not leads yet. LINE leads are counted in the inbox, which Machi reports 3 times a day (new, needs a reply, hot). The cost in Boonchu's time per Reel is not counted yet; Plato could log the hours.

fixes.name: Keyed start links per source
fixes.how: Each channel has its own aybkk.net/start link, so we see taps per channel. With the spend, that gives cost per tap, and new students are matched to a channel by hand.

fixes.name: /start ladder question lead capture
fixes.how: A 4-tap question replaces the contact form and opens LINE with the answer already typed, which should bring more leads from the same visits. Not counted yet.
fixes.source: machiavelli.md, Open items 2026-11-02 (5 Nov part: 'ladder question' lead capture, PR #91)

fixes.name: Monday letter list
fixes.how: People sign up free by email, LINE or WeChat and get a short letter every Monday, so they stay warm leads at no ad cost. The Telegram button on the sign-up is hidden, because the Telegram channel is not created yet.
fixes.source: public/bkk.html section id 'letter' (origin/main); machiavelli.md Open items 2026-10-20 (newsletter)

fixes.name: Free gift guide by comment keyword (ManyChat MYSORE)
fixes.how: Commenting MYSORE should send the free 'Your First Mysore Class' guide by DM through ManyChat (a tool that sends automatic replies), a lead at no ad cost; delivery is unproven, and the free plan may skip new commenters (fix: Essential plan, USD 14 a month, billed yearly, needs Boonchu's yes). Count who then books a first morning, not just who gets the guide.
fixes.source: machiavelli.md, Open items 2026-10-12 (FREE GIFT DELIVERY audit), 2026-10-19 (ManyChat vs MCP); Reminders 'Sun 25 Oct 2026'

terms.next: Boonchu, at the 2 Dec Google check: divide each ad's spend by its Book and LINE taps on the staff page (/start/google, and /start/gsearch if the Final URL was changed to /start/gsearch; the notes don't confirm it). Machi writes the two numbers in the brief.
terms.careful: Trap: cutting cost per lead with freebies or discounts. Leads who only want the free thing never book; judge a lead by whether they come for a first morning.

terms.bar: Getting her attention costs more when many other men want her too, or when you are not very attractive to her. Then the problem is how you look and talk (the creative) or what you bring (the offer).
terms.meaning: The creative is the ad or post itself: words, pictures, video. The offer is what people get for what they pay. When leads cost too much, the cause is usually strong competition, a weak creative, or a weak offer.
terms.shala: A rival sells 'a month of yoga THB 1,500' and pays Google to show its ad when people search our name. Our creative is the Reels, posts and the hero line at the top of aybkk.net: 'From 331 baht a class +VAT, with a teacher who knows your body' (+VAT means 7% Thai tax is added). Our offer is the habit system, same practice, same time, a teacher who notices when you're gone, at the price list from 12 Nov.
terms.indepth: For Gen #3, the Chinese group, the offer is 30 days of In-Depth Mysore with Boonchu (11 Jan to 9 Feb 2027, 12 seats, a certificate of completion, not teacher training or authorization); the English group's dates and format are not set yet. The creative rests on Boonchu's direct authorization from the late Sharath Jois, said exactly as 'Authorized Level 2 by R. Sharath Jois' and never made to sound bigger than it is. The pitch is retention: how to build students who stay for years.
terms.count: Not counted directly. It shows up in other numbers: low click-through points to the creative, many chats with no pass point to the offer. Plato could log which hook and which habit number each Reel used next to its watch time, and Machi could note in the brief each time someone says 'too expensive'.

fixes.name: The Habit Gap: what we sell
fixes.how: People don't lack tools, they quit; we sell the habit (same practice, same time, a teacher who notices) and the outcome (stronger, calmer, better sleep), not asanas or flexibility. A cheap month without a teacher who notices is a different thing, so we stop competing on price.
fixes.source: /home/user/bots-mem/bots/direction.md, 'The one idea' (4 Oct 2026); /home/user/aybkk-workshop/CLAUDE.md, 'Business direction: The Habit Gap'

fixes.name: Answer to cheap competitor offers: habit system, never a discount
fixes.how: When a rival sells a cheap month and pays Google to show its ad when people search our name, we never discount and never name them. We lead with outcome and proof (Authorized Level 2, since 2013, beginners welcome), and give a price per day only after that; the per-day figure must be worked out again at the 12 Nov prices.
fixes.source: machiavelli.md, Open items 2026-10-15 (COMPETITOR PRICE HOOKS)

fixes.name: Stakes test (Rule #1)
fixes.how: Nothing ships until it has two lines on top: 'Stakes' (what happens if this problem is not solved) and 'Why care' (the reason in the viewer's life now). A piece that cannot answer both is weak creative and goes back.
fixes.source: /home/user/bots-mem/bots/direction.md, 'RULE #1: THE STAKES TEST (Boonchu, 2 Nov 2026)'

fixes.name: Authorization as the anchor
fixes.how: All 180K positioning rests on Boonchu's direct multi-year authorization from the late Sharath Jois (18-year relationship, hosted him in Bangkok 2018 and 2024), never made to sound bigger than it is. No rival can copy that.
fixes.source: /home/user/aybkk-workshop/CLAUDE.md, 'Custom Slash Commands > /remotecontrol'

fixes.name: No pressure tricks
fixes.how: Never a fake choice, never a made-up higher price shown to make ours look small, never a higher price for richer buyers. The site says 'One price for everyone. Clear and simple.'
fixes.source: /home/user/bots-mem/bots/voice/hormozi-advice-voice.md, '4. Do not copy'; public/bkk.html line id 'fair' (origin/main)

terms.next: Machi: work out the 'price per day' line again at the 12 Nov prices (the old line used 32,000 for 6 months; it is now 34,200 + VAT) and send it to Boonchu for his OK, so the answer to cheap rivals uses today's numbers.
terms.careful: Trap: never show a made-up or fake higher price to make ours look small.

terms.bar: Spending a lot is fine if the girl you meet truly fits you and is likely to say yes. A good match is a qualified lead; how often the good matches say yes is the close rate.
terms.meaning: A qualified lead is someone who truly fits: the right level, the right reason, and able to come and pay. Close rate is how many of those leads finally say yes and pay.
terms.shala: A qualified shala lead lives in Bangkok or stays a while and wants a morning habit, not one class for a photo. The first-timer sheet (planned) has the desk ask 'live in Bangkok?' and 'how did you find us?'.
terms.indepth: A qualified lead knows the Primary Series by heart and has Mysore and led class experience. Many are teachers or studio owners who want students who stay. The price is given only on the call, after the application with a practice video.
terms.count: Applications come in through two apply forms: aybkk.net/in-depth (English) and the private Chinese page cn.aybkk.net/in-depth (shared on WeChat only). Carne logs 180K leads each morning in the encrypted lead list, and posts carry counts only: 2 leads since 28 Sep (12 Oct and 10 Nov). Close rate (paid seats out of calls) is not counted yet; Boonchu holds the call and payment numbers.

fixes.name: Name-Disqualify-Release qualifying copy
fixes.how: The 'this is not for you' section names who the program is for, says plainly who it is not for, and lets the rest go, so only people who fit apply.
fixes.source: /home/user/aybkk-workshop/CLAUDE.md, 'Custom Slash Commands > /qualify'

fixes.name: DM triage, no selling in DMs

terms.bar: She stays with you, night after night, year after year. That is good retention.
terms.meaning: Retention is how many customers stay, month after month. For a shala it matters most, because a student who stays keeps practising and keeps renewing.
terms.shala: A student keeps coming at the same time, books every class, sees 'mornings practised' grow on their profile on aybkk.net, does the 12-week check, and renews. The habit system is built for this: same practice, same time, a teacher who notices when you're gone.
terms.indepth: For In-Depth, retention means graduates stay close: they keep practising, read the Monday letter and host workshops in China. It is also what we sell them: how to build students who stay for years.
terms.count: Door check-ins at /door (the teacher-side check-in page) count who comes, not who books, and the Rezerv pass list (Rezerv is the old booking system) shows who holds a pass. The number to watch: new students still coming at week 4 and week 12. Caveat: door check-ins are not complete yet. The Rezerv import has not reached the live system (board 14 Nov: 'Rezerv import still waits'), and M still checked in on Rezerv as of 3 Nov, so check-ins are split between Rezerv and /door; a number from /door alone would be too low until the import is done and everyone is checked in at /door. Not counted yet; Neo could build the count and Machi report it.

fixes.how: At week 0, 6 and 12 the student enters resting heart rate, sleep and how they feel, and the profile shows the change since week 0. Seeing their own progress gives a reason to keep coming; how many students use it is not counted yet.

terms.bar: Then the two of you do more together, and the relationship grows over the years. In the Reel: you add upsells and raise the lifetime value.
terms.meaning: An upsell is a next, bigger step offered to someone who already buys, like a longer pass. Lifetime value is all the money one customer brings over all the years they stay.
terms.shala: A student moves from a drop-in or the 8-class pack to 1 month, then to 3, 6 or 12 months, renews, and may buy a tee (790 THB + VAT) or join a workshop. The 6-month pass is marked 'teacher's pick', and the per-class price shows that longer passes cost less per morning.
terms.indepth: A shala student or a letter reader can grow into the 180K program, and a graduate can host workshops in China. The 180K seat is the biggest single step on the ladder.
terms.count: Each student's passes over time are in the Rezerv pass list and the aybkk.net pass records; lifetime value is all the passes one student bought, added up. terms.bar: She leaves you. The Reel calls it a 'charm problem': you stopped being someone she wanted to stay with.
terms.meaning: Churn is how many customers stop and leave in a time period. It is the opposite of retention: high churn means students leak out as fast as new ones come in.
terms.shala: A student's pass ends and they do not renew, or they stop coming in month 2 or 3 while the pass still runs. Carne's research on Ashtanga students online says experienced students leave over forceful adjustments, a teacher who walks away, harshness and no attention, and that anger about price is often really 'no attention'. Holders of old-price passes may also not renew at the new list.
terms.indepth: For In-Depth, churn is a graduate who drifts away after the program: stops practising, stops reading the letter, never hosts a workshop. It also shows up as a lead who goes quiet.
terms.count: Not counted yet. Neo could count pass holders who did not renew within 14 days of their pass end (Rezerv pass list plus aybkk.net passes) and students with an active pass not seen at /door for 7+ days; Machi would report it weekly. Caveat: door check-ins are not complete yet. The Rezerv import has not reached the live system (board 14 Nov), and M still checked in on Rezerv as of 3 Nov, so a not-seen count from /door alone would wrongly show students as missing until everyone is checked in at /door.

big_lesson: Look at retention first: the shala is a habit business, so a student who stays for years is worth more than many new faces who quit in month 2, and Hormozi also says to work on retention first. Before more ads or more posts, count how many new students are still coming at week 4 and week 12, and finish the habit tools that keep them (the See you tomorrow list, the streak, renewal shown with proof). That count needs complete door check-ins: until the Rezerv import is done and everyone is checked in at /door, a number from /door alone will be too low.
sum: Example only, not a real student. A student who buys one month (9,600 THB) and then quits brings 9,600 THB. A student who buys a 12-month pass (63,600 THB) and renews it twice at today's price, 3 years in all, brings 3 × 63,600 = 190,800 THB: almost 20 times as much (190,800 ÷ 9,600 = 19.9), and more than one 180,000 baht In-Depth seat. 63,600 is the 12-month price on aybkk.net since 12 Nov. All shala prices here are before VAT: 7% Thai VAT is added on top, so one 12-month pass costs the student 63,600 + 7% = 68,052 THB.
